Radio

Make a single selection among a set of alternatives (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

Bind the name of the currently selected item to the value via value.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

Page({
  data: {
    radio: '1',
  },

  onChange(event) {
    this.setData({
      radio: event.detail,
    });
  },
});

2. Arrange Horizontally

After setting the direction attribute to horizontal, the radio button group will become horizontally arranged.


<maui-radio-group
  value='{{ radio }}'
  bind:change='onChange'
  direction='horizontal'
>
  <maui-radio name='1'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

3. Disabled State

Disable option switching through the disabled attribute, and set diabled on Radio to disable individual options.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' disabled bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

4. Custom Shape

Set the shape attribute to square, and the shape of the radio button will become a square.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1' shape='square'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2' shape='square'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

5. Custom Color

Set the icon color of the checked state through the checked-color attribute.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1' checked-color='#07c160'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2' checked-color='#07c160'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

6. Custom Size

The size of the icon can be customized through the icon-size attribute.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1' icon-size='24px'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2' icon-size='24px'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

7. Custom Icon

custom-icon can set the icon when checked


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1' custom-icon='../example/customIcon.png'>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2' custom-icon='../example/customIcon.png'>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

8. Disable Label Click

Radio button text clicks can be disabled by setting the label-disabled attribute.


<maui-radio-group value='{{ radio }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-radio name='1' label-disabled>radio 1</maui-radio>
  <maui-radio name='2' label-disabled>radio 2</maui-radio>
</maui-radio-group>

API

RadioGroup Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
name Identifier when submitting within the form String -
value The identifier of the currently selected item Any -
disabled Whether to disable all radio buttons Boolean false
direction Arrangement direction, optional value is horizontal String vertical

Radio Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
name identifier String -
shape The shape of the checkbox, optional value is square String round
disabled Whether it is disabled Boolean false
label-disabled Whether to disable clicks on text content Boolean false
label-position Text position, optional value is left String right
icon-size Icon size, default unit is px String | Number 20px
checked-color Selected state color String #1989fa
custom-icon Custom icon, support name or image link Boolean false

Radio Events

Event Description Parameter
bind:change Event triggered when bound value changes The name of the currently selected item

RadioGroup Events

Event Description Parameter
bind:change Event triggered when bound value changes The name of the currently selected item
